Title: Submit valid name and phone number on User Details page
Preconditions: Streamlit app is running (`streamlit run ui/app.py`) and user is on the Contact Us page
Steps: 1. In the sidebar, select "User Details" | 2. Enter a valid full name in the "Full Name" field | 3. Enter a valid phone number in the "Phone Number" field | 4. Click "Submit"
Expected Result: A green success message "Thank you, Jane Doe! Your details have been saved." is shown, the form clears, and the new row appears in the "Submitted Details" table below the form

Title: Navigate from Contact Us to User Details and submit
Preconditions: App is running and user starts on the Home page
Steps: 1. Select "Contact Us" in the sidebar | 2. Fill in Name, Email, and Message fields and click "Send Message" | 3. Confirm the success message and the hint pointing to "User Details" | 4. Select "User Details" in the sidebar | 5. Enter name and phone number and click "Submit" | 6. Reload the app (`at.run()` / browser refresh) and select "User Details" again
Test Data: Contact form: Name="John Smith", Email="john@example.com", Message="Test inquiry"; User Details: Name="John Smith", Phone="555-987-6543"
Expected Result: Contact Us submission shows a success message; after navigating to User Details and submitting, the entry "John Smith / 555-987-6543" persists in data/user_details.csv and is still visible in the "Submitted Details" table after reload

Title: Submit phone number at minimum and maximum allowed length
Preconditions: App is running and user is on the User Details page
Steps: 1. Enter a valid name | 2. Enter a phone number with exactly 7 digits and click "Submit" | 3. Re-open the form, enter a valid name, and enter a phone number with exactly 15 characters (digits/spaces/hyphens, optional leading +) and click "Submit"
Test Data: Case A: Name="Al Lee", Phone="1234567"; Case B: Name="Al Lee", Phone="+123 456-789-012"
Expected Result: Both submissions are accepted (no validation error) since 7 and 15 characters are the inclusive boundary of the accepted pattern, and both rows are saved and displayed in the Submitted Details table

Title: User Details table displays previously submitted entries
Preconditions: At least one user detail record already exists in data/user_details.csv from a prior submission
Steps: 1. Launch the app and navigate to "User Details" without submitting a new entry | 2. Observe the "Submitted Details" section below the form
Test Data: Pre-existing CSV row: Name="Existing User", Phone="+1 222-333-4444"
Expected Result: The "Submitted Details" subheader and table are rendered automatically, showing timestamp, name, and phone_number columns including the pre-existing "Existing User" row, with no submission required

Title: Reject submission with empty name and invalid phone number
Preconditions: App is running and user is on the User Details page
Steps: 1. Leave the "Full Name" field empty | 2. Enter a phone number containing letters (e.g. "abc") in the "Phone Number" field | 3. Click "Submit"
Expected Result: Two red error messages are shown: "Name is required." and "Phone number must contain 7-15 digits and may include spaces, hyphens, or a leading +."; no row is written to data/user_details.csv and no success message appears
